However, the credit profile is constrained by a weak liquidity position, evidenced by a current ratio of 0.83 (current liabilities exceeding current assets by $226M), which introduces short-term refinancing risks and prevents an upper-medium grade rating. Balancing the robust operating profitability against the tight short-term liquidity and moderate leverage suggests a solid investment-grade rating at the lower end of the BBB category.

DECISION: BBB-
